zh:
面向销售、CRM经理和开发人员的方案说明。核对日期：2026-10-30。本文记录讨论结论与实施边界，不代表WhatsApp已接入、已开户或已通过验收。

## 建议：第一期采用Hybrid只接收归档

UPER直接对接Meta，不强制引入Chatwoot等第三方收件箱。销售使用公司持有的WhatsApp Business App号码人工回复；CRM通过官方共存事件接收客户来信及App发送回显，按客户渠道身份关联Lead。第一期暂不开放CRM／AI通过API发送，不做自动营销、群发或新的自动任务，不自动改变Tier或销售阶段。

Hybrid（混合接待模式）是UPER方案名称。Meta对应能力叫Coexistence（共存），不是新的产品套餐。先验证共存资格、事件与设备完整性，再决定是否适合正式使用；如不满足准确归档要求，再评估API统一收发。

客户 → 官方号码 → Business App人工接待；客户来信＋App发送回显 → 官方Webhook → CRM原文归档 → AI整理／人工采用。

## 账号与开通的区别

| 类型 | 如何使用／开通 | 与CRM的关系 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 个人WhatsApp Messenger | 手机号码注册个人App | 不支持通过官方Cloud API直接读取个人聊天 |
| WhatsApp Business App | 注册公司持有的号码，完善企业资料 | 基础聊天免费；注册App不自动获得消息API |
| Business Platform／Cloud API | Meta业务资产下的WABA、业务号码与API授权；配置Webhook | 可编程收发；新号码可直接接入，不必先注册App |
| Hybrid／Coexistence | 为符合资格的现有Business App号码走专门共存流程 | 同号保留App，并同步受支持的官方事件；不是普通API开户自动具备 |

Meta Business Portfolio、WhatsApp Business Account（WABA）、号码、验证方式和凭证归UPER管理。销售登录CRM的员工身份与公司的WhatsApp号码分开。付费Meta Verified徽章、Meta业务验证及API授权不是同一件事；Lark管理员也不等于Meta管理员。

共存的可用地区、账号活跃度、现有连接、Embedded Signup及接入方资格需要单独确认。直接对接Meta的方向，不等于自己的普通开发者应用必然能立即开通共存。不得为尝试接入而先删除现有账号或清空历史。

## 接入方式比较

| 方式 | 多人接待 | 原文与Lead关联 | 成本／限制 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 个人App或wa.me跳转 | 原生关联设备 | 打开聊天不等于已发送；CRM不能据此获得完整原文 | 基础聊天免费，不满足官方API归档目标 |
| Business App单独使用 | 标准最多4台关联设备；部分付费套餐更多 | App保留聊天，UPER仍需人工记录 | 无基础聊天API消息费；有可选增值费 |
| Cloud API直接接CRM | 销售分别登录CRM，不依靠App设备名额 | 经CRM通道可记录客户身份、发送员工、原文和状态 | 开发维护＋API消息费；需实现窗口、模板及故障恢复 |
| 第三方共享收件箱 | 使用现成员工工作台 | 仍需把外部消息、客户及负责人映射到UPER | 订阅／席位／联系人费可能叠加Meta费用；字段导出需核验 |
| Hybrid只接收归档 | 销售在App接待，CRM管理客户 | 接收来信＋App发送回显；员工身份可能未知 | 低消息成本，但共存资格、设备及消息类型有限制 |
| 本地助手／界面自动化 | 代替人点击App | 可见内容、稳定消息ID、去重及发送结果难保证 | 不作为正式通道；界面变化、错发、重复及官方使用规则风险 |

App标准支持一台主手机及最多4台关联设备。官方部分Meta Verified套餐支持6／8／10台，且可能提供聊天分配；以账号可用套餐为准。不能把“App有多人分配”当成“所有发送员工可通过API准确导出”。

## 广告获客与Lead关联

正式Instagram／Facebook Click-to-WhatsApp消息广告按Business账号和Meta业务资产流程连接，可使用Business App或Platform。客户仍可用个人WhatsApp发来消息。普通wa.me短链接能打开聊天，但不等于原生广告目标，不保证返回广告归因信息。

1. 客户实际发送消息后，按渠道、官方账号范围和客户外部标识（如当前接口提供的wa_id／其他用户标识）查找已有Lead绑定。不要用昵称或AI猜测身份，也不要硬编码外部标识永远等于手机号。
2. 已有绑定则追加原文。陌生身份建立最小Lead候选／登记方案，实施前明确必填和身份校验；未知资料留空，不能绕过现有登记规则填默认值。仅匹配问卷自填号码、共享号码或多个Lead时，人工核对。
3. 持久化实际收到的referral、source_id、source_url及ctwa_clid等字段；字段缺失就保留缺失。广告名、广告组和Campaign必要时按授权补全，不从聊天内容猜测。
4. 同一客户再次来自另一广告，保留新增触点，不能覆盖首次来源或重复建Lead。ctwa_clid识别点击，不能当客户ID；未发消息的点击不能当成已登记客户。
5. 手机App消息回显不提供具体员工时，记录“公司Business App发送／员工未知”。负责人、设备操作者和消息发送者不能互相替代。

## 收费参考：App、API与Hybrid

| 动作 | Meta消息收费边界 |
| --- | --- |
| Business App普通一对一聊天 | 基础聊天不按API消息费计价；仍有网络和号码费用 |
| 客户来信通过Webhook进入CRM | 入站消息不收服务消息费；不会消耗出站1,000条免费额度 |
| 共存模式下App发送及官方回显归档 | 当前共存服务商文档说明App发送不产生WhatsApp API消息费；服务商自身可能收费，具体接入需核实 |
| CRM／AI调用API发送 | 适用API消息类别、收件人市场、免费窗口及额度；人工发送也不自动免费 |
| 接口接入与员工席位 | Meta直接接入无额外平台访问费；自有CRM无第三方席位订阅，但有开发、服务器、存储与AI费用 |
| Meta Verified／增强商业广播／投放广告 | 可选订阅、付费广播及广告费独立核算；地区和账号资格影响报价，不能套用API单价 |

Meta官方FAQ已明确：2026-10-01起，每个业务号码每月前1,000条服务消息免费，从第1,001条起按条收费。这是公司发出的服务回复条数，不是1,000位客户或会话。营销、事务、验证码模板不共享此额度。旧介绍页中的“24小时客服回复无限免费”不能继续用于预算。[官方FAQ](https://whatsappbusiness.com/resources/faq/)

下表为预算参考，未含税、未扣适用免费窗口及折扣。具体单价来自服务商公开表；Meta详细价目页面需登录，本轮未在UPER结算账号核验。正式采用前必须核对账号费率、生效日及结算币种。

| 发给印尼号码的类别 | USD价目／条 | IDR价目／条 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 服务回复，超过免费额度 | $0.025 | Rp356.65 |
| 营销模板 | $0.0411 | Rp586.33 |
| 普通事务／验证码模板 | $0.025 | Rp356.65 |

USD与IDR是不同结算价目，不是当天汇率换算。国际验证码有独立资格和费率，不能一概套用普通验证码价。[美元参考](https://sleekflow.io/id-id/blog/biaya-whatsapp-business-api) · [印尼盾参考](https://chakrahq.com/id/help/chat/getting-started/understanding-pricing-and-charges)

预算例：一个号码，每月500位客户、公司各发10条非广告免费窗口内的服务回复，共5,000条，扣1,000条后为4,000条。按以上单价计算，API消息费为$100，或IDR价目Rp1,426,600，未含税。若都从App普通聊天发送，基础API消息费为0；开发、网络、存储、可选订阅仍有成本。不是固定月租。

## 第三方费用仅作备选参考

第三方收件箱不是Meta接入的必需条件。以下是核对日官网展示的美元标价，不是UPER采购报价；结算周期、税费、API权限、用户和联系人额度以订单为准。订阅费不能抵扣Meta消息费。

| 方案 | 展示价格 | 需要核对 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chatwoot Cloud Startups / Business | $19 / $39，每员工每月 | 免费Cloud方案仅网站聊天；团队、自动化、审计及数据保留依套餐 |
| Chatwoot自托管社区版 | 软件席位费$0 | 服务器、备份、升级仍有成本；高级角色权限及其他企业能力不全部包含 |
| respond.io Growth | 年付折算$159/月起 | Developer API、Webhook事件范围、月活跃联系人及用户超额费；月付另核对 |

不因为已有CRM就认为无需接入开发，也不因为开源免费就认为无需运维。[Chatwoot Cloud价格](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) · [自托管价格](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing/self-hosted-plans) · [respond.io价格](https://respond.io/pricing)

## 24小时窗口与广告免费窗口

24小时客服窗口主要决定能否发自由格式回复；客户最新来信刷新窗口。窗口内仍适用当前服务消息计费，窗口外通常需批准模板。模板类别由实际用途及Meta审核决定，不能把课程推广命名为“通知”就按事务价。

Wati于2026-10更新的文档说明，符合条件的CTWA入口从2026-09-28起可有最长7天免费消息窗口，要求首次来信后24小时内回复。部分Meta介绍页仍写72小时。正式接入前核对生效条件及平台返回信息，不在CRM硬编码7天全部免费或任意内容都能发送。普通主页链接不保证符合资格；广告费、外部AI费仍独立。[最新广告窗口说明](https://support.wati.io/en/articles/11865651-general-faqs-ctwa) · [API计费变更](https://support.wati.io/en/articles/16954666-whatsapp-business-platform-api-pricing-changes-service-messages-and-click-to-message-ads)

## 与现有CRM的边界及分期

当前“准备联系”仅打开wa.me并预填草稿，不证明发送成功。现有对话结构围绕网站访客，实施时需增加渠道身份关联，不能为WhatsApp客户伪造网站visitor会话。本文是规划，不代表当前对话Tab已支持WhatsApp实时同步。

对话Tab保存完整双向原文、附件和实际时间；跟进页显示沟通结论并定位原消息；客户资料展示当前采用值；AI整理属于派生内容，不能替代原文或自动确认测评、报名、客户约定及销售阶段。消息送达、已读、有效沟通和首次联系要求是不同概念，不能直接互相推断。

第一期：核实一个公司号码的共存资格，建立只接收事件的适配层，保存身份、消息ID、原文、附件、事件时间、接收时间和广告触点。保留Webhook原事件及处理结果，验签、幂等去重、乱序与断线恢复；不增加API发送入口。

第二期：把可靠原文接入已有依据定位和AI提取，验证采用与冲突处理。第三期仅在需要时评估CRM发送、模板、费用提示和发送结果查询；发送超时不能盲目重发。任何阶段不新增自动任务、不自动改Tier、不重放通知。

## 接入前验收门槛

- 号码／WABA资产归属、共存接入资格与所需Meta应用能力确认；不删除现有账号试错。
- 客户首次来信、已有Lead、重复手机号、共享号码、转交负责人后续聊均不串客户。
- 真实广告首条消息与自然来信均保留原文；归因字段缺失不伪造，重复触点不重复建客户。
- 手机及实际使用的Mac／Windows／Web关联设备逐一核对客户来信和App回显。部分设备／消息类型可能不支持，不能把已收部分标为全部同步。
- 文字、图片、语音、文件、引用以及编辑／撤回等事件验证；不支持时明确标注，转写不覆盖附件原文。
- 重复、乱序、断线及恢复不丢失或重复归档；核对条数与内容，不以Webhook返回成功代替完整验收。
- API发送保持关闭；不因归档触发自动回复、任务、Tier或阶段改变；通知是否产生必须单独定义并授权。

## 来源与维护

官方产品与设备：[Business App](https://faq.whatsapp.com/641572844337957) · [关联设备](https://faq.whatsapp.com/878854700132604/?cms_platform=android) · [Meta Verified](https://faq.whatsapp.com/3872729742954601/?helpref=uf_share) · [付费商业广播](https://about.fb.com/news/2025/04/ways-to-manage-your-businesses-chats-on-whatsapp/) · [广告业务关联](https://faq.whatsapp.com/1164217254479464/?cms_platform=android)

技术边界：[共存Webhook事件](https://docs.360dialog.com/partner/onboarding/whatsapp-coexistence/coexistence-webhooks) · [共存功能与费用限制（服务商文档）](https://respond.io/help/whatsapp/whatsapp-coexistence) · [Meta详细计费页（需登录）](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/business-messaging/whatsapp/pricing)

接入前、正式购买前及后续费率变更时重新核验来源、日期和账号适用性。服务商报价不等于UPER已经取得的Meta正式账单；文档更新不授权开户、发布、自动消息或修改业务规则。
en:
Decision guide for sales, CRM managers and developers. Checked: 2026-10-30. This records the proposed architecture and its limits. WhatsApp onboarding, integration and acceptance have not been completed.

## Recommendation: receive-only Hybrid first

Connect UPER directly to Meta; Chatwoot or another inbox is optional. Sales reply manually from the company-owned WhatsApp Business App number. CRM receives customer messages and App-sent echoes through official Coexistence events, then links the external customer identity to a Lead. Do not enable CRM/AI API sending in phase one. Do not add automated marketing, broadcasts or tasks, or change Tier or sales stage automatically.

Hybrid is UPER's operating model. Coexistence is Meta's underlying capability, not a separate pricing plan. Verify eligibility, event coverage and actual devices before adoption. If reliable archiving cannot be achieved, assess API-only CRM messaging.

Customer → official number → manual Business App support; incoming messages + App echoes → official webhook → CRM originals → AI organization / human adoption.

## Accounts and onboarding

| Type | Setup and use | CRM implications |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Personal WhatsApp Messenger | Register the personal app with a number | No official Cloud API access to personal chats |
| WhatsApp Business App | Register a company-owned number and business profile | Basic chat is free; App registration does not grant messaging API access |
| Business Platform / Cloud API | WABA, business number and API authorization under Meta business assets; configure webhooks | Programmable messaging; a new number need not first register in the App |
| Hybrid / Coexistence | Dedicated onboarding for an eligible existing Business App number | Same number retains App access and supported events; ordinary API setup does not automatically enable it |

UPER controls the Meta Business Portfolio, WhatsApp Business Account (WABA), number, verification method and credentials. CRM employee identities are separate from the company number. Paid Meta Verified, business verification and API authorization are distinct. Lark administration grants no Meta rights.

Check regional availability, number activity, existing connections, Embedded Signup and onboarding-party eligibility. Direct Meta integration does not guarantee that an ordinary developer app can immediately enable Coexistence. Do not delete an existing account or clear history to experiment.

## Integration options

| Option | Team operation | Originals and Lead linking | Cost / limits |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Personal App or wa.me link | Native linked devices | Opening chat proves neither sending nor CRM capture | Basic chat is free; no official personal-message archiving API |
| Business App alone | Up to 4 standard linked devices; some paid plans allow more | History stays in the App; UPER records manually | No basic API chat fee; optional paid features |
| Cloud API directly into CRM | Separate employee logins, independent of App device slots | Record customer identity, sender, originals and status on the CRM path | Development, operations and API message fees; window, template and recovery handling required |
| Third-party shared inbox | Ready-made staff workspace | Still needs external-message, customer and owner mapping | Subscription, seat or contact fees may add to Meta charges; verify exported fields |
| Receive-only Hybrid | App support with CRM customer management | Incoming messages and App echoes; employee sender may be unknown | Low messaging cost; eligibility, devices and message types limit coverage |
| Local assistant / UI automation | Assistant clicks the App | Visible history, stable IDs, deduplication and send outcomes are hard to guarantee | Not the official production channel; UI changes, wrong sends, duplicates and usage-policy risks |

Standard App use supports one primary phone plus up to 4 linked devices. Some Meta Verified plans allow 6/8/10 and chat assignment, subject to availability. Assignment does not prove every employee sender can be exported accurately through API.

## Advertising and Lead identity

Native Instagram/Facebook Click-to-WhatsApp message ads connect through Business accounts and Meta assets, using the App or Platform. Customers can still use personal WhatsApp. A wa.me link opens chat but is not equivalent to a native ad destination and does not guarantee ad attribution.

1. After an actual incoming message, find the Lead binding by channel, official-account scope and external customer identifier, such as wa_id or the identifier returned by the current API. Never match by nickname or AI guesses, or assume IDs always equal phone numbers.
2. Append to an existing binding. Define a minimal new-Lead flow before implementation; missing fields remain empty and existing registration validation still applies. A self-reported phone match, shared number or multiple Leads needs review.
3. Preserve the received referral, source_id, source_url and ctwa_clid when present. Keep absent values absent. Resolve campaign/ad names through authorized APIs where needed, never from message guesses.
4. A returning customer from another ad adds a touchpoint, not another Lead or an overwritten first source. ctwa_clid identifies a click, not a customer. A click without a message is not a registered customer.
5. If App echoes do not identify the employee, record company Business App / employee unknown. Owner, device operator and message sender are different facts.

## Cost reference: App, API and Hybrid

| Action | Meta messaging boundary |
| --- | --- |
| Ordinary one-to-one Business App chat | No basic API message charge; network and number costs remain |
| Customer messages received by CRM webhook | No inbound service-message fee; does not consume the outbound 1,000 allowance |
| App sending and official echo archiving in Coexistence | Current provider documentation says App sends have no WhatsApp API fee; provider fees and actual setup still need checking |
| CRM / AI sends through API | API category, recipient market, free-window and allowance rules apply, including human sends |
| Direct API access and employees | No extra Meta platform-access fee; own CRM avoids third-party seat subscriptions but needs development, hosting, storage and AI processing |
| Meta Verified / enhanced broadcasts / ads | Optional subscriptions, paid broadcasts and advertising are separate; regional eligibility affects quotes |

Meta confirms that from 2026-10-01, each business number receives 1,000 free service messages monthly, with charging from the 1,001st. These are outgoing service replies, not customers or conversations. Marketing, utility and authentication templates do not share this allowance. Do not budget using older unlimited-free-service wording. [Official FAQ](https://whatsappbusiness.com/resources/faq/)

Budget reference only: excludes tax, qualifying free windows and discounts. Specific rates below come from provider tables. Meta's detailed rate page requires login; UPER billing-account rates were not checked. Confirm effective dates, currency and account applicability before purchase.

| Category to Indonesian numbers | USD rate / message | IDR rate / message |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Service beyond free allowance | $0.025 | Rp356.65 |
| Marketing template | $0.0411 | Rp586.33 |
| Standard utility / authentication template | $0.025 | Rp356.65 |

USD and IDR are separate billing cards, not a daily currency conversion. International authentication has separate eligibility and rates. [USD reference](https://sleekflow.io/id-id/blog/biaya-whatsapp-business-api) · [IDR reference](https://chakrahq.com/id/help/chat/getting-started/understanding-pricing-and-charges)

Example: one number, 500 customers monthly, 10 service replies each outside ad-free windows: 5,000 replies minus 1,000 free = 4,000 billable. At the above rates, $100 or Rp1,426,600 before tax. Ordinary App sending has zero basic API message fees, but implementation, network, storage and optional subscriptions remain. This is not a fixed monthly fee.

## Third-party costs: optional alternatives

A third-party inbox is not required for Meta access. These are displayed USD prices on the check date, not a UPER quotation. Confirm billing period, tax, API access, user/contact limits and overages at checkout. Subscriptions do not offset Meta message fees.

| Option | Displayed price | Check before purchase |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Chatwoot Cloud Startups / Business | $19 / $39 per agent monthly | Free Cloud supports website chat only; teams, automation, audit and retention depend on plan |
| Chatwoot self-hosted Community | $0 software seat fee | Hosting, backups and upgrades cost money; advanced roles and enterprise features are not all included |
| respond.io Growth | From $159/month equivalent, billed yearly | Developer API, webhook coverage, active-contact and user overages; verify monthly billing separately |

An existing CRM still needs integration work; free software still needs operations. [Chatwoot Cloud pricing](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) · [Self-hosted pricing](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing/self-hosted-plans) · [respond.io pricing](https://respond.io/pricing)

## Service and ad-free windows

The 24-hour service window governs free-form replies and refreshes on the latest customer message. Current service billing still applies; outside the window an approved template is normally required. Template classification depends on actual purpose and Meta review; renaming a promotion as a notification does not make it utility.

Wati's October 2026 guidance describes up to 7 free days for eligible CTWA entry points from 2026-09-28, conditional on replying within 24 hours of first contact. Some Meta overview pages still say 72 hours. Verify eligibility and returned platform information before implementation. Do not hardcode seven free days or unrestricted sending. Ordinary profile links do not guarantee eligibility; ad and external AI costs remain separate. ## Existing CRM boundaries and phases

Prepare contact currently opens wa.me with draft text; it does not prove sending. Existing conversations depend on web visitor sessions. Add channel identity support rather than inventing website visitors for WhatsApp. This is a plan, not an already-integrated live chat feature.

Conversations retain originals, attachments and actual timestamps. Follow-up shows conclusions linked to source messages. Profile shows adopted values. AI output remains derived; it cannot replace originals or establish assessment completion, enrollment, agreements or stage changes. Delivered, read, effective communication and first-contact requirements are distinct.

Phase one: verify one company number and create a receive-only adapter. Preserve identity, message ID, content, attachments, event and receipt times, ad touchpoints, raw webhook events and processing outcomes. Verify signatures, deduplicate and handle reordering and outages. No API send action.

Phase two: connect reliable originals to existing evidence and AI adoption/conflict handling. Phase three, only if needed: CRM sending, templates, cost feedback and send-result queries. Never blindly resend after a timeout. No new automated tasks, automatic Tier changes or notification replay.

## Acceptance gates

- Confirm number/WABA ownership, Coexistence onboarding eligibility and required Meta app capabilities without deleting existing accounts.
- Verify first contact, existing Leads, duplicate/shared phones and continued chats after owner transfer without cross-customer leakage.
- Test a real ad first-message path and organic contact; preserve missing attribution, originals and repeat touchpoints without duplicate customers.
- Check the actual phone, Mac, Windows and Web devices for incoming messages and App echoes. Unsupported devices/types must not appear fully synchronized.
- Test text, image, audio, documents, quoted messages and edit/revoke events. Label unsupported content; transcripts never replace originals.
- Repeated, reordered and recovered events must not duplicate or lose archives. Compare counts and content, not just webhook success.
- Keep API sending off. Archiving must not manufacture replies, tasks, Tier or stage changes. Notification behavior needs a separate decision and authorization.

## Rekomendasi: Hybrid penerimaan saja untuk tahap pertama

Hubungkan UPER langsung ke Meta; Chatwoot atau inbox pihak ketiga bersifat opsional. Sales membalas manual melalui nomor WhatsApp Business App milik perusahaan. Tahap pertama tidak mengaktifkan pengiriman API dari CRM/AI, pemasaran otomatis, broadcast, tugas otomatis baru, atau perubahan Tier dan tahap penjualan otomatis.

Hybrid adalah nama model kerja UPER. Coexistence adalah kemampuan Meta yang mendasarinya, bukan paket tarif terpisah. Verifikasi kelayakan, cakupan peristiwa, dan perangkat nyata sebelum digunakan. Jika arsip tidak dapat diandalkan, evaluasi pengiriman dan penerimaan terpusat lewat API.

## Batas CRM saat ini dan tahapan

Siapkan kontak saat ini membuka wa.me dengan draf, bukan membuktikan pesan terkirim. Percakapan saat ini bergantung pada sesi pengunjung web. Tambahkan identitas kanal; jangan membuat pengunjung web palsu untuk pelanggan WhatsApp. Ini rencana, bukan fitur WhatsApp langsung yang sudah tersedia.

Tab Percakapan menyimpan teks asli, lampiran, dan waktu kejadian. Tindak lanjut menampilkan kesimpulan yang menuju pesan sumber. Profil menampilkan nilai yang diterapkan. AI adalah hasil turunan; tidak menggantikan asli atau mengesahkan asesmen, pendaftaran, kesepakatan, dan tahap. Terkirim ke penerima, dibaca, komunikasi efektif, dan kewajiban kontak pertama berbeda.

Tahap pertama: verifikasi satu nomor perusahaan dan buat adapter penerimaan saja. Simpan identitas, ID pesan, isi, lampiran, waktu kejadian/penerimaan, titik iklan, peristiwa webhook asli, dan hasil proses. Verifikasi tanda tangan, deduplikasi, urutan terbalik, serta pemulihan gangguan. Tanpa tombol kirim API.

Tahap kedua: hubungkan arsip yang andal ke bukti dan proses AI/penerapan/konflik yang ada. Tahap ketiga hanya jika diperlukan: pengiriman CRM, template, informasi biaya, dan pemeriksaan hasil kirim. Jangan mengirim ulang sembarang setelah timeout. Tanpa tugas otomatis baru, perubahan Tier otomatis, atau pemutaran ulang notifikasi.

## Syarat penerimaan sebelum integrasi

- Pastikan kepemilikan nomor/WABA, kelayakan onboarding Coexistence, dan kemampuan aplikasi Meta tanpa menghapus akun lama.
- Uji pesan pertama, Lead lama, nomor ganda/bersama, dan percakapan setelah pengalihan penanggung jawab tanpa data silang.
- Uji pesan pertama iklan nyata serta kontak organik; simpan asli, atribusi kosong, dan titik berulang tanpa duplikasi pelanggan.
- Periksa ponsel serta perangkat Mac, Windows, dan Web yang benar-benar digunakan untuk pesan masuk dan echo App. Perangkat/tipe yang tidak didukung tidak boleh ditandai sinkron lengkap.
- Uji teks, gambar, audio, dokumen, kutipan, edit, dan penarikan pesan. Tandai yang tidak didukung; transkrip tidak menggantikan asli.
- Peristiwa berulang, terlambat, dan pemulihan tidak boleh menggandakan atau menghilangkan arsip. Bandingkan jumlah dan isi, bukan hanya webhook sukses.
- Pengiriman API tetap mati. Pengarsipan tidak membuat balasan, tugas, Tier, atau perubahan tahap. Perilaku notifikasi perlu keputusan dan otorisasi terpisah.
